entities.summary: Count Monaldo Leopardi was an Italian philosopher, nobleman, politician and writer, notable as one of the main Italian intellectuals of the counter-revolution. His son, Giacomo Leopardi, was a poet and thinker with opposite views, which were likely the main cause of their discord.
